title: OpenGL
author: JG
description: add textures for triangle lists, using texture reference number and coordinates, according to standard format
releaseNotes: A TriangleList takes 'texture', the name of a texture added with SC.renderer.AddTexture, and 'textureCoordinates', (u, v) per point; OpenGL draws the triangles with the texture (revision2026c step RG6.11.3)
